extension.summary: 中国天气：实时天气、多日预报、中文城市搜索与中国气象预警
China Weather: current conditions, multi-day forecast, Chinese city search and official CMA weather alerts
extension.description: 基于中央气象台（nmc.cn）与中国天气网（weather.com.cn）公开接口的 Kodi 天气插件。提供实时实况、7 天预报、中文城市名搜索与切换、国家级气象预警（含预警类型与蓝/黄/橙/红等级）、生活指数、UTF-8 中文界面与 strings.po 中英文本地化。无需 API Key，无需注册。

A Kodi weather add-on powered by the public endpoints of China's National Meteorological Center (nmc.cn) and China Weather Network (weather.com.cn). Features live observations, a 7-day forecast, Chinese city search and switching, official severe-weather alerts with type and Blue/Yellow/Orange/Red severity, life indices, a fully UTF-8 Chinese UI and strings.po localisation. No API key or registration required.
extension.disclaimer: 气象数据来自公开接口，仅供个人参考；预警与决策请以中央气象台及当地气象部门正式发布为准。
Data comes from public endpoints for personal reference only. Always follow official issuances for safety-critical decisions.
